articleTitle: Model of stegosystem images on the basis of pseudonoise codes
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Analysed receptions and algorithms of introduction of information in graphic files due to the use of bits with minimum meaningfulness on the basis of pseudonoise codes which can be successfully used for the concealment of any types of files in the case of containers with graphic information.

articleTitle: SPICE macro-model of magnetic tunnel nanostructure for digital applications and memory cells
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents macro-model and circuit of a spin transfer torque magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ), implemented using two voltage-dependent resistances for parallel and antiparallel layer magnetization. Macro-model suitable for use in any circuit simulators, the problems previously encountered in the convergence of SPICE-like programs eliminated. The efficiency of the model is demonstrated for a MRAM memory, simulation results showed high accuracy and adequacy of the proposed macro-model.

articleTitle: Methods and VLSI-structures for neural element implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper methods and basic structure for neural element hardware support are given.

articleTitle: A survey of thresholding algorithms on yarn images
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The problem of image segmentation is considered. Popular thresholding methods are reviewed and tested on images presenting yarn of different hairiness. Results of image segmentation provided by the regarded thresholding approaches are presented, compared and analyzed. Especially their capabilities of extracting single fibers protruding from the yarn core are examined. Outcomes of the analysis are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Information technologies of speaker recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper analysis of technologies of speaker recognition to perform the speaker's identification and verification is presented. Automatic speaker recognition is the use of a machine to recognize a person from a spoken phrase.

articleTitle: Automation of graphical dependencies presentation in ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Presented algorithm automation of graphical dependencies in ANSYS environment.

articleTitle: Data-processing method for determination thermophysical parameters of composite materials
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The work is devoted to the development of applied methodology for determination of thermophysical parameters of composite materials.

articleTitle: Research of artificial neural networks usage in data mining and semantic integration
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes the possibilities of using artificial neural networks in the following fields of machine learning: data mining and semantic integration in large databases. Possibility of using analog components for developing neural networks is investigated.

articleTitle: Development of macroparametric exchange method for heterogeneous CAD and structure of integrated design environment for MEMS Gyroscopes
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper, a macroparametric method for exchanging parametric information of a CAD model of microelecromechanical gyroscope between heterogeneous CAD systems is proposed. A structure of an integrated design environment is developed.

articleTitle: Structural diagram of information environment for exchanging drawing fragments like quick messages in CAD systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The structure for exchanging information and drawings between remote designers Internet-based IM clients.

articleTitle: Algorithm for clustering web documents
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The classical clastering algorithms work with vector based document models. In this paper we introduce graph-based representation of web documents and clustering algorithms that based on graph representation of web documents.

articleTitle: Image and video super-resolution via accurate motion estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Super-resolution has relying on accurate motion estimation between the frames for a successful process. In this paper we propose to calculate quality coefficients for motion vectors and use calculated coefficients for accurate motion estimation process. All requirements for super resolution process: image registrations and fusion solutions are determined. Basic image spatial resolution algorithms were investigated. New enhanced super resolution algorithm was proposed. The proposed algorithm is designed to realize resolution upconversion on video sequences, trying to reduce the gap between high-resolution displays and low quality video content.

articleTitle: New concepts for teaching computer programming to future Information Technology engineers
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the problems of teaching computer programming to Information Technology students based on author's own observations are discussed and several proposals are given on how to make the programming skill more attainable by the students and thus improve the effectiveness of programming course.

articleTitle: Precise edge detection in images of melted specimens of metals and alloys
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper problem of accurate edge detection in images of heat emitting objects is considered. Firstly the theory of edge detection is surveyed. A review of existing techniques for edge detection is provided. Especially methods based on analysis of image derivatives are regarded. Results of applying the considered methods to images of melted specimens of metals and alloys are presented, analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Electre method for choosing an e-learning platform
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The problem of LMS selection can be ascribed to the wide section of decision making problems and can be solved using one of the ELECTRE method. The use of ELECTRE III method proved the effective selection of an e-leaning IT system. The method uses the quantitative and qualitative approach that expands it's range of use. The system selection is dependant from the decision maker preferences, which are very often omitted in other than ELECTRE III methods of IT e-learning system selection.

articleTitle: The development of information and technical provisions of various CAD's
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The development of information and technical provisions of CAD's systems is one of most important features in setup process. This project will make all of “hard” work and give to user configured system, ready to work.

articleTitle: Structure development of computer-aided noise barriers design system
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Today there is no single integral system that allow automating the process of estimation of environment pollution with noise generated by transport flows and in case if it exceeds permitted levels for this type of urban areas to determine sizes of noise barriers to maintain sound-level within the limits of existing norms. Therefore there is a task to develop such integral system.

articleTitle: Methods for reduction of thermal effects for analysis of images presenting melted specimens of metals and alloys
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents methods for reduction of thermal phenomena effects appearing during the analysis of images presenting heat-emitting objects. The proposed methods utilize drop shape analysis algorithms in process of removing aura from segmented images of melted metals. Results of applying the proposed solution to the drop shape analysis process are presented, analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Structure-functional schemes of wide-range frequency multipliers of sampled harmonic signals
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The structure-functional schemes of frequency multipliers of sampled harmonic signals are given. The schemes can process precisely signals with any finite values of amplitudes and frequencies. Signal transformation is fulfilled linearly without amplitude and frequency distortion. Multipliers do not require an additional filtering of output signals.

articleTitle: Imitation model for research of conveyer weigher
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the mathematical model to research a conveyer weigher work is suggested and the recommendations on the wegher's constructive parameters for the developers are given.

articleTitle: Design principles and sensitivity analysis of MEMS cantilever sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The aim of this work is to establish design principles and model equations for analysing sensitivity of MEMS cantilever sensors. Sensitivity and quality factor were estimated to be the most important parameters for MEMS cantilever sensors.

articleTitle: The control agent with fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper a controller construction on the basis of the intelligent agent with fuzzy logic is considered. The algorithm of a fuzzy logic inference of the agent decision-making is described. Results of computer modelling of control process are received and analysed.

articleTitle: Modelling of combustion process in the gas test engine
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Paper presents results of modelling gas engine thermal cycle using AVL FIRE and KIVA 3V software. There are described three combustion models used in above mentioned software. Comparison of modelling results of thermal cycle of IC engine is presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Solving of typification problem by selection of isomorphic subgraphs
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the example for solving of typification problem by selection of isomorphic subgraphs.

articleTitle: MPI in GRID systems: An overview
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

articleTitle: Multicore intelligent system of pattern recognition

abstract: An intelligent recognition system “MAP” of multidimensional sensory patterns for analysis of gaseous, liquid and heterogeneous matters is developed with a hardware on basis of surface acoustic wave (SAW) micro-nanosensors on a chip “electronic tongue” (e-tongue) and “electronic nose” (e-nose), also an optical microtomography in broadband frequency range, described multicore and parallel processing technologies for fast self-learning and on-line analysis of information sensory patterns.

publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Piezoresistive cantilever for mechanical force sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Piezoresistive Cantilever for Mechanical Force Sensors"
by Volodymyr Bychkovsky, Mykhaylo Lobur,
in the Proceedings of the 2010 VI-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH), April 2010, pp. 143-146

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains substantial duplication of original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"Piezoresistive Cantilever for Mechanical Force Sensors"

by T. Chu Duc, J.F. Creemer, P.J.F. Swart, P.M. Sarra
in the Proceedings of the 2005 Semiconductor Advances for Future Electronics (SAFE) 2005


This paper describes piezoresistive cantilever force sensors that are used to evaluate the impact force between microhandling tools and microparticles in the nano-Newton range. The 500 nm-thick piezoresistive sensors are made from epitaxial silicon on single crystal silicon. This cantilever is based on conventional silicon wafers and fabricated using bulk micromachining. The cantilevers are 300–500 µm long, 10–20 µm high, and 10–18 µm wide. The applied force on this sensor is parallel to wafer surface. This structure can eliminate the effect of the vertical force, increasing the sensitivity and accuracy of the system. The force sensitivity of implemented sensors ranges from 150 to 300 V/N. The force resolution estimated at 6 nN.

articleTitle: Financial appraisal of e-business transformation process using real options method
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Managing the process of transferring business activities to a global network requires the development and implementation of proper strategy. The aim of the paper is to analyze the problem of financial appraisal of e-business strategy development. The compound real options method was introduced and proposed as method for evaluation. The advantages and disadvantages of this approach were presented.

articleTitle: New ideas in high temperature computerized measurements of surface properties
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper the ideas in the high temperature computerized measurements of wetting angle and surface tension are presented. The main goals of given ideas are to expand the usability of measurement stand and to improve the accuracy and repeatability of the measurement results.

articleTitle: A segmentation method for microscope images of BY-2 tobacco cells in suspension cultures
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes a segmentation method of BY-2 tobacco cells proceeded from suspension cultures. The method separates foreground objects by the detection of their boundaries and then eliminates cell clumps and artefacts based on their different inside brightness and skeleton structures. Single cell objects are restored by the thickening of binary cell residues remaining after morphological operation of cleaning the holes under the cell chain masks. Experimental results of the segmentation for a series of BY-2 images as well as cell enumeration and segmentation errors are presented.

articleTitle: Comparison of similarity measures of speech signals fragments

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of the MEMS disc element considering its finite width
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the mathematical model of the MEMS disc element considering its width value is proposed. This model considers influence on disk resonance frequencies values of disk geometrical parameters. The first, second and third mode values were calculated. Stresses and stains in disc were simulated. Also in this work gives several proposition for future use of the analyses proposed for the telecommunication systems elements (transformer, filter, ect.) development.

articleTitle: Increasing accuracy of measurement of amplitudes difference of low-frequency harmonious signals

articleTitle: Pattern silhouette features for image classification
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

abstract: Results of ab initio simulation of electronic and magnetic properties of TlMeX<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> compounds (Me=Ga, In. articleTitle: Reliability parameters of compound embedded systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: For unsymmetrical compound embedded systems ramified to level 2, reliability models are worked out for the cases when the lifetime of ageing output elements is circumscribed by the Rayleigh distribution. Main reliability parameters of compound embedded systems are examined in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of the combinatorial models for innovative design techniques
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Application of the Perfect Combinatorial Sequences Theory, namely the concept of Ideal Ring Bundles (IRBs), for improving the quality indices of engineering devices or systems based on combinatorial technique is proposed in the paper. For example, resolving ability of radar is known to be of very dependent from positioning of elements in antenna array; high-performance technology of information coding and design of communication signals with favorable correlation properties demands an optimal placement of the signals in spatially and temporally distributed systems, and other examples of technological problems relating to the optimal placement of spatially or temporally distributed systems can be cited. However, a lot of well-known engineering devices, technologies or systems with non-uniform structure are very distant from perfect fulfillment of the design with respect to performance reliability, resolving ability and the other significant operating characteristics of the system. An ordinary IRB is ring-like sequence of positive integers, which form perfect partitions of a finite interval [1,S] of integers. The sum of connected subsequences of an IRB enumerate the set of integers [1,S] exactly once. This property makes IRBs useful in applications, which need to partition sets with the smallest possible number of intersections.

articleTitle: Automatic evaluation of examination tasks in the form of function plot
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the approach to automatic exam sheets evaluation is presented. In our task the exam is written on paper forms and scanned. The bitmaps are processed to extract the specific task area and then the task is evaluated with aid of image processing and analysis. In this work we present the algorithm for automatic evaluation of function plot. The algorithm has been verified against the set of 47 sheets. Simultaneously the works have been graded be a qualified teacher.

articleTitle: Development an ontology of Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) and nano-electromechanical systems (NEMS)
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the process of development a OntoMEMS ontology of Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) and Nano-electromechanical Systems (NEMS) are present.

articleTitle: Interconnection discrete harmonic transforms sizes 2n on base of circular convolutions
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The general method of efficient computation discrete harmonic transforms for size the integer power of two using of circular convolutions is considered. Hash array discrete basis matrixes of harmonic transforms are analysed. Interconnection hash arrays between harmonic transforms are determined.

articleTitle: A communication conflict removing method in collaborative project systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper observed data objects replicated at multiple computers that can be synchronized using synchronization messages exchanged over a network. The messages include a current operation parameter and a previous operation parameter that are processed to determine how and when the replicated data objects should be manipulated. Data in the message can also indicate a unique priority level of the sending computer with respect to the other computers.

articleTitle: Visualization of chemical composition in an archaeological sample using prompt gamma-ray neutron activation analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Many methods are being developed by scientists, archaeologists and historians to study different aspects of the archaeological samples. The paper presents an advanced non-intrusive technique to identify the type of sample and to predict its provenance by visualising the chemical composition.

articleTitle: Collecting data of user's activities in interface layout of MEMS CAD software
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Approaches to the collection and accumulation of information parameters from user interface software CAD Software (on MEMS example) presented to further systematize and project evaluation to improve the quality of software user interfaces.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Experimental comparison of segmentation algorithms on images of heat-emitting objects and methods for their accuracy improvement
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper problem of accurate segmentation of images presenting melted specimens of metal is considered. Firstly the theory of thermal phenomena influence on recorded images is explained. A review of most popular edge-based segmentation methods is provided. Results of applying drop shape analysis algorithm to segmented images are presented, analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Methods and schemes of measuring the electric circuit resistance parameter value
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A short analysis of the existing methods and schemes of measuring the unknown value of the electric circuit resistance parameter is conducted in present article. Their principle advantages and disadvantages are specified from the point of view of their prospective improvement aimed at solution of the problem of electric resistance measuring accuracy in MEMS technologies.

articleTitle: Colour Petri nets theory applied to MEMS's analysis model
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: MEMS model on the base of colour Petri net for task analysis at the system level of design is presented.

articleTitle: Subsystem of technological editing of topology of plated circuits
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The features of work of subsystem of the automatic editing of topology of PCBS are examined in this work. The considered subsystem allows to execute in the automatic mode editing above topology of PCBS, with the purpose of minimization of an amount of the technologically justified places with a minimum clearance.

articleTitle: Creation the media with desired refraction coefficient
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A combination of asymptotic approach and computational modeling is used for solution of problem to create the media with the prescribed electrodynamical characteristic, in particular, a refraction coefficient. The initial diffraction problem is considered under the assumptions ka ≪ 1, d≫a, where a is the size of the particles and d is the distance between the neighboring particles. On the wavelength one may have many small particles. Impedance boundary conditions are assumed on the boundaries of small particles. The results of numerical simulation show good agreement with the theory. They open a way to numerical simulation of the method for creating materials with a desired refraction coefficient.

articleTitle: Graphical postprocessor for scientific visualization of temperature distribution issues in microelectronic chips
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes the client-server architecture of graphical postprocessor for scientific visualization of temperature distribution issues in microelectronic chips and the overheat visualization algorithm that generates three-dimensional model on which critical temperature regions are noticeable.

publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

articleTitle: Models of data processing for expert opinion about the state and dynamic situation in technical systems on the basis of laser sensors

articleTitle: Research and design of integrated software agents for automated autoconfiguration of information environments for MEMS CAD

articleTitle: Modeling of capacitive accelerometer constructions
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Modeling of capacitive accelerometers with different types of fastening are described.

articleTitle: Contour compression using wavelet and Piecewise Linear transforms
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The efficiency of the Periodic Haar Piecewise-Linear (PHL) transform and the Wavelet Transform (WT) in the compression of contour data is presented in this paper. The periodic Haar piecewise linear transform PHL is introduced. This transform is generally based on integrating the periodic Haar functions. Test contours extracted from binary images are represented by two one-dimensional sequences x(i) and y(i) representing the cartesian coordinates of the boundary points of the contour. The contour sequences are transformed and some of the spectral coefficients are selected for inverse transformation. The threshold and zonal methods of compression are investigated. Comparison of the PHL transform and the Wavelet transform with respect to the mean square error versus the compression ratio is reported. It is shown that the Daubechies-4 Wavelet and the PHL transforms have a close performance at low compression ratios, however, the PHL transform has a better compression efficiency at high compression ratios.

articleTitle: Coloured timed petri nets and traffic noise model
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: We present an idea of hierarchical way of designing the traffic model to predict noise pollution of regular towns based on CTPN.

articleTitle: Development of mathematical model of spring suspension system for microelectromechanical angular Velocity Sensor (MEMS gyroscope)
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper a mathematical model for calculating constructive parameters (thickness and length) of the spring element of the spring suspension system for the micromechanical gyroscope (microelectromechanical angular velocity sensor) is developed. articleTitle: Optimization model to research assess the impact of quality and cost indicators of product life cycle

articleTitle: Wireless Gateway Programming Model

articleTitle: Chemical sensors. Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this article a review of chemical sensors, their classification and application. We also propose a new method that reduces sensor response time.

articleTitle: Interval estimation of set images statistical parameters

We have determined the peculiarities of each representation model usage and given instances of practical experiments.

articleTitle: B+-tree in database design for decision-making information system
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes the design of the database for decision-making information system based of the B+-tree principles of database indexation.

articleTitle: On possibility of advantages join of formant and modulation methods of speech intelligibility evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

articleTitle: Data- and software development for CSP solution subsystem during MEMS design
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design

articleTitle: Prohibiting copying screen algorithm for content security protection
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: As described below in the article, an information security architecture, is designed for taking over all attempts of copying information from hard disk drive, or screen, and is to set licensing and additional restrictions on access information such as - user authentication, limiting instances and usage time.

articleTitle: System analysis of realization of physical laws symmetry for contemporary signal energodynamics for MEMS synthesis
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: There is shown the cause and effect of some kind bifurcation and even dissociation of physicists thinking which have been provoked by pandomination of so-called general relativity theory. A system analysis of invariance concept and term origination instead of relativity ones and real perceiving of physical laws symmetry for investigations and its necessity for education process is given.

articleTitle: Spectrum patterns analysis by clustering
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: An automated approach based on clustering algorithms and software to spectrum pattern analysis is considered. Investigation of spectral lines extraction and selected element percentage admixture determination problems are presented.

articleTitle: Web System for Biometric Verification of Facial Portraits
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to propose a concept and a prototype of a web-based computer system that allows to verify a conformance of the facial image with chosen set of characteristics included in the ISO/ICAO norms. The employed algorithms involve several pattern recognition procedures such as template matching, morphological operators, filtering and calculating several color and intensity characteristics. As a result, the level of conformance is presented to the user, allowing him to make all the necessary corrections in order to produce an image acceptable by the document issuing organization. The experiments showed that chosen approach gives satisfactory results and high level of certainty. Proposed system is implemented as a web service providing simple yet usable graphical front-end (WWW page) connected with server-side processing unit.

articleTitle: Subsystem for analysis tasks solving on the system level of MEMS design based on queuing systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the article the basic features of the developed subsystem for the tasks analysis on the base of queuing systems are described. The algorithm of work and flow diagram of subsystem are presented.

articleTitle: Automated algorithmic software synthesis CAD MEMS using the extended algebra of algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper shows the methodology and the feasibility of using algorithmic synthesis software CAD MEMS extended algebra of algorithms, such as providing greater depth to minimize the formulas algorithms compared to classical algebra of algorithms.

articleTitle: Production complex innovative strucrure project
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Analyzed the functioning of the industrial complex as a subsystem in the system of market relations, analyzed the process of designing an innovative structure model of domestic industry enterprise, analyzed the procedures of structure synthesis.

articleTitle: Artificial neural oscillators in robotics
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Neural oscillators offer simple and robust solutions to problems such as locomotion and dynamic manipulation. Unfortunately, the parameters of these systems are notoriously difficult to tune. This paper presents brief review of using artificial neural oscillators in different types of robots such as dish-spinning robots, fish-robots, giant swing robots etc. Open questions in this field are formulated.

articleTitle: Designing a computer-assisted translation system for multi-lingual catalogue and advertising brochure translations
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools help a human translator in his work. Such programs maintain a database with short translated expressions, as a source of suggestions. A major problem is lack of mature applications for handling desktop publishing (DTP) files, which pose a difficulty because of their graphical diversity. In this paper we present functional and technical requirements of a system currently being developed, and present experiments with algorithmic solutions to short word suggestion lists and recognition of non-translatable symbols.

articleTitle: Hierarchical approach to nanodesign
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: NWChem package of quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics calculations was examined as a possible grid application in the frameworks of BalticGrid-II FP7 project. Realization of hierarchical approach to simulation of nanosystems on the basis of NWChem is discussed. NWChem installation and benchmark testing results on various architectures are described. Job submission from g-lite environment is discussed. Some preliminary results of carbon nanotubes array properties' calculations are presented.

articleTitle: Neural network information technologies of pattern recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper provides an introduction to the field of artificial neural network by brief reviewing some neural net models that can be used for pattern recognition. There are made a few open problems in this area of research.

articleTitle: Reliability of MEMS: Effects of different stress conditions and mechanical fatigue failure detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The mechanical fatigue behavior of gold microbeams is analyzed. Dedicated devices have been designed and built able to produce alternate loading on gold specimens; the electrostatic actuation is used as driving force. Gold beams are tested under both bending and tensile alternate loadings. Results were used to plot S-N curves and fatigue Goodman-Smith diagram in order to estimate the fatigue limit of the material in presence of mean and alternate stress conditions. The surface topography evolution is studied and failure modes are discussed.

articleTitle: Language-independent word-based text compression with fast decompression
publicationTitle: 2010 Proceedings of VIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A classic idea to improve text compression is to replace words with references to a text dictionary, either external or stored together with the archive. We advocate for the second option, as even with one language in mind (e.g., English) it is rather impossible to have a single dictionary fitting well different sorts of modern texts. There are basically two problems to solve, which are how to assign codewords to individual words from the parsed text, and how to represent the dictionary compactly. The resulting data are input for a backend compressor. Since in many scenarios texts are decompressed (read) more often than compressed (written), we focus on LZ77 backend compression algorithms, in particular Deflate, used in zip/gzip standards, whose well-known asset is very fast decompression.
